# Rudraansh Yatra
> Rudraansh Yatra is a NIDHI-certified (EUK000357) and MSME-registered (UDYAM-UK-09-0012985) local tour operator and Himalayan expedition specialist headquartered in Pithoragarh, Uttarakhand, India. Founded in 2015 by native mountaineer and THSC-certified expedition director Dheerendra Rautela, the organization directly executes pilgrimages and high-altitude treks across the Kumaon Himalayas—including Adi Kailash, Om Parvat, Khaliya Top, and Darma Valley—with 100% direct ground control, dedicated 4x4 mountain vehicles, and zero middlemen.

- **Headquarters**: 1st Floor Above Maniram Punetha & Sons, Simalgair Bazaar, Pithoragarh, Uttarakhand — 262501, India
- **Coordinates**: 29.5855307, 80.212559
- **Phone**: +91 7617617651
- **Email**: info@rudraanshyatra.com
- **Official Website**: [Rudraansh Yatra](https://rudraanshyatra.com)
- **Legal Registrations**: MSME UDYAM-UK-09-0012985, Ministry of Tourism NIDHI EUK000357, THSC Certified Tour Manager Operations
- **Verified Reputation**: 5.0/5.0 stars based on 39 verified Google Maps traveler reviews; recognized with TripAdvisor Traveller's Choice
- **Operational Model**: Direct end-to-end ground handling, dedicated 4x4 Mahindra Bolero fleet, seasoned native Kumaoni high-altitude drivers, in-person Inner Line Permit (ILP) liaison with SDM Dharchula and Pithoragarh, certified medical oxygen kits on all vehicles, and sustainable community partnerships with indigenous Rung tribal homestays in Gunji, Nabi, Kuti, and Daktu.

## Core Pilgrimage & Trek Packages
- [Adi Kailash & Om Parvat Yatra](https://rudraanshyatra.com/adi-kailash): Comprehensive pilgrimage packages including 3D/2N ex-Pithoragarh (₹18,000), 6D/5N ex-Kathgodam (₹30,000), and 6D/5N ex-Delhi (₹35,000) covering Parvati Sarovar, Gauri Kund, Gunji, and Om Parvat view with Inner Line Permits, 4x4 Boleros, and homestay accommodation.
- [Darma Valley Exploration](https://rudraanshyatra.com/darma-valley): 5D/4N offbeat border valley expedition through Dhauliganga gorge to Daktu village (3,100 m) with Rung homestays, carved wooden heritage, and the 4 km hike to Panchachuli Base Camp (Meola Glacier).
- [Khaliya Top Alpine Trek](https://rudraanshyatra.com/khaliya-top): 4D/3N beginner-friendly high-altitude alpine meadow trek (3,500 m / 11,500 ft) originating from Munsiyari offering panoramic 360-degree vistas of Panchachuli I–V, Rajrambha, and Hardeol peaks.
- [Mt. Kailash Yatra Support](https://rudraanshyatra.com/mt-kailash): Border pilgrimage coordination, acclimatization arrangements, and ground assistance along western Nepal and Tibet transit corridors.

## Sacred Temples & Kumaon Cultural Circuit
- [Patal Bhuvaneshwar Cave Temple](https://rudraanshyatra.com/patal-bhuvaneshwar): Complete guide to the subterranean limestone cave shrine dedicated to Lord Shiva, located 90 feet below ground level in Gangolihat.
- [Jageshwar Dham](https://rudraanshyatra.com/jageshwar-dham): Spiritual guide to the 8th–12th century complex of 124 stone temples dedicated to Lord Shiva nestled in deodar groves near Almora.
- [Chitai Golu Devta Temple](https://rudraanshyatra.com/chitai-golu-devta): The sacred temple of the God of Justice in Almora, known for written petitions and thousands of brass bells.
- [Kainchi Dham Ashram](https://rudraanshyatra.com/kainchi-dham): Spiritual ashram of Neem Karoli Baba near Bhowali, Nainital along the Kumaon pilgrimage corridor.
- [Haat Kalika Temple](https://rudraanshyatra.com/haat-kalika-temple): Historic Shakti Peeth and military patron shrine in Gangolihat.
- [Kali Mata Temple Kalapani](https://rudraanshyatra.com/kali-mata-temple-kalapani): Sacred source of the Kali River at the tri-junction of India, Nepal, and Tibet.
- [Kamakhya Devi Temple Pithoragarh](https://rudraanshyatra.com/kamakhya-devi-temple-pithoragarh): Revered Shakti temple offering sweeping panoramic views of Pithoragarh and the Soar Valley.
- [Mostamanu Temple Pithoragarh](https://rudraanshyatra.com/mostamanu-temple-pithoragarh): Traditional hilltop deity temple located in the Chandak hills near Pithoragarh.
